events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect worktree state, dev server, and t460 ancestry
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && git status --short | head -20; git log --oneline -3; git branch --show-current; ps -p 43146 -o pid,command | tail -1; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main HEAD && echo T460_IN || echo T460_MISSING; git log --oneline -1 origin/main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktrees and branch ancestry on origin
events.input: $ git worktree list | head; git merge-base --is-ancestor 90578a13 origin/main && echo T459_ON_MAIN; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main origin/main && echo T460_ON_MAIN || echo T460_NOT_ON_MAIN; git log --oneline origin/main..origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main | head; git log --oneline 90578a13..origin/main | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create fresh worktree at origin/main and merge v2 branch
events.input: $ git worktree prune && git worktree add -q -b t459-finish /private/tmp/t459m origin/main 2>&1 | tail -2; cd /private/tmp/t459m && git merge --no-edit origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main 2>&1 | tail -5; git status --short | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify merge contents and tooling
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && git log --oneline -2; grep -rn "Refresh your OS context" app/src | head -3; grep -n "start-os-download" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -2; ls app/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo APP_NM || echo NO_APP_NM; ls cloud/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo CLOUD_NM || echo NO_CLOUD_NM; ls app/scripts | grep -E "probe-(guides|day-prompts|day-model|flows)|check-guides"; head -30 cloud/scripts/build.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Install app and cloud dependencies
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent 2>&1 | tail -3) && cd ../cloud && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent 2>&1 | tail -3); echo EXIT $?

events.text: The old worktree was cleared, so I rebuilt it from origin/main with the v2 branch merged in. Next I'm running the static probes.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run static probes and inspect probe-guides usage
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && mkdir -p evidence/T-459 && for p in check-guides probe-day-model probe-day-prompts; do node app/scripts/$p.mjs > evidence/T-459/$p.txt 2>&1; echo "$p exit $?"; tail -2 evidence/T-459/$p.txt; done; sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -iE "usage|BASE|url|port|argv" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server on port 4391 and wait for guides page
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && (npx next dev -p 4391 > /private/tmp/t459m-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4391/debug/guides 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 3; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4391/debug/guides; lsof -ti:4391 | head -3
